messages.body_plain:
Dear evaluating mentors,
mid-term evals are due in the next 24 hours.
please submit yours as soon as possible.
if your eval is not submitted before the deadline, then R project may
be severely penalized, and admins may not allow you to mentor again in
the future.
thanks
Toby
